title: St. Catherine Monastery Tour - Sinai's Hidden Treasure
overview: Explore the historic St. Catherine Monastery, one of the oldest Christian monasteries, with deep significance for Christianity, Islam, and Judaism. Visit the Burning Bush, the Skull Room, and the shopping district of Dahab.
highlights: St. Catherine Monastery - The oldest working Christian monastery
The Burning Bush - The Biblical bush where God spoke to Moses
The Skull Room - Contains the bones of all the monks who lived there (not always open)
A Piece of St. Catherine's Finger Bone - A relic on display inside the monastery
A Mosque Inside the Monastery - A unique place of worship
Dahab City - The biggest shopping area in South Sinai for handicrafts, jewelry, perfumes, and carpets
Lunch in Dahab - Enjoy a delicious meal at a local restaurant
extra_tips: The Skull Room is not always open.
No visa required for this trip.
Tailor-made private tours available for large groups upon request.
recommendations: Bring a breakfast box for the morning journey
